<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>Alison has confirmed that the meeting has been booked for Thursday, November 19, at 14:30. My next step is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

The `send_confirmation_email` function requires `day`, `start`, and `body`.
- `day`: "Thu"
- `start`: "14:30"
- `body`: I need to craft a suitable email body. It should include the meeting details (date, time, duration, attendees) and perhaps a brief note.

Email body draft:
"Dear Partners,

This email confirms your 30-minute meeting scheduled for:

Date: Thursday, November 19, 2026
Time: 2:30 PM - 3:00 PM Eastern

Attendees: Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, David Okafor

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Brad (AI Scheduling Assistant)"

This seems appropriate.
